items.q: What do you actually sound like?
items.a: Alt-pop with rap verses and rock choruses. Piano and synth under everything, a ukulele doing things it probably shouldn't, and two people playing all of it live.
Not usually — we would rather play our own. Ask anyway, for the right night one might sneak into the set.
Send a venue, a date and a rough idea of the night to FiftyFivePawns@proton.me or fiftyfivepawns@gmail.com. We are in Taverny, just outside Paris.

items.q: When is the first song coming out?
items.a: When it is actually good, not before. Nothing is released yet — the news section and the Discord hear about it first.
